# LoanMath
Free US loan calculators with transparent, exact-cent math.

## Tools
- /mortgage-calculator: Mortgage payment with property tax, insurance, PMI (auto-drop at 80% LTV), HOA, and extra-payment savings.
- /auto-loan-calculator: Car payment with trade-in, negative equity, state sales-tax rules, and fees.
- /personal-loan-calculator: Personal loan payment with origination fee and effective APR.
- /mortgage/{amount}-mortgage-payment: Payment tables for specific loan amounts across rates and terms.

All calculations run client-side; formulas are documented on each page.
